summary.en: Child (15 kg) with fever and cough for two days. Calpol syrup while fever lasts and Ambrodil S syrup for cough. CBC if fever does not settle in three days, review after five days.

tests.name: CBC
tests.when: if fever does not settle in three days

open_questions: Calpol is to be given while the fever lasts. Stop once fever is gone?
